contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP GORDIANVS PIVS FEL AVG ; R/ PROVID AVG

A contemporary copy of a Roman silver plated radiate with a copper alloy core of Gordian III (238-244). Obv legend: IMP GORDIANVS PIVS FEL AVG : radiate and draped bust right, seen from behind. Rev legend: PROVID AVG : Providentia standing left, holding baton over globe and vertical sceptre. Finder's number 2
